system.description:
Starting at 10th Level, you have mastered the application of medicine to such a degree that your hands move with certainty, your tools never tremble, and your treatment always cuts straight to the issue.

When you use the Treat Wounds skill Action, if you have a Medicine Kit, if you succeed in getting a Critical Healing, you recover 2 spent charges of the kit.

Additionally, when using a Medicine Kit, you can use any Emergency Stabilization as a Bonus action.
